title: Oracle Tech Architecture and Middleware-Oracle Cloud HCM Technical with Fast Formula-Senior
SAP Basis-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY GDS CONSULTING – SAP BASIS SENIOR**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 As a Senior SAP BASIS Specialist, you will be responsible for managing and optimizing our SAP BASIS infrastructure and operations. This senior role offers you the opportunity to ensure system stability, security, and high performance across complex SAP landscapes.
   

  

 You will work closely with IT teams, functional consultants, and business stakeholders to implement best practices, troubleshoot complex technical issues, and support system upgrades, patches, and migrations. Your expertise will be essential in maintaining system health, ensuring compliance with IT policies, and supporting disaster recovery and business continuity efforts.
   

  

 In this role, you will also provide guidance and mentorship to junior BASIS team members, fostering knowledge sharing and professional growth. You will be part of a collaborative team that values technical excellence and innovation, delivering reliable SAP BASIS services to support business operations
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Responsible for decision\-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.
* Performance monitoring \& tuning, Problem analysis \& resolution, and other activities required to maintain system integrity SAP administration on UNIX \& Windows
* System /System copy
* ABAP \+ Java\-dual stack
* Add\-on and Support Pack application and troubleshooting
* Kernel Upgrade
* Client copies and export\-import
* TMS administration and configuration and troubleshooting Transport errors
* SAP system monitoring and thorough analysis of issues
* SAP parameter change, operation mode setup, Logon group setup
* SAP Role based Authorization knowledge \- Role creation and modification
* Spool administration and troubleshooting spool/printer issues
* OSS Note application
* Experience in Single \-Sign On, Web Dispatcher
* Experience in working SAP on public cloud and private cloud.
* Experience in working with cloud service providers like AWS, Azure and GCP.
* SAP Solution Manager experience with basic and advanced configuration.
* Hands\-on experience with SAP user provisioning, authorization troubleshooting, and role assignments.
* Basic knowledge of OS/DB migration processes.
* Familiarity with Web Dispatcher, Gateway, and SAP integration components.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Should have 4 to 7 years of experience in SAP Basis domain.
* Solid hands\-on experience in SAP system administration, including installation, configuration, upgrades, and performance optimization.
* Should understand SAP architecture, transport management, kernel updates, and system refresh processes.
* Proficient in administering SAP HANA (monitoring, tuning, backup/recoveries, basic troubleshooting).
* Experience supporting landscapes like S/4HANA, ECC, BW/4HANA, PO/PI, Fiori, Solution Manager, etc.
* Strong SAP BTP knowledge, including key services, integration patterns, and administration fundamentals.
* Strong working experience with RISE with SAP environments and operational activities.
* Strong documentation skills for system delivery, ensuring clear, structured, and audit‑ready technical documentation.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with clients and stakeholders.
* Knowledge of Solution Manager features such as CHARM, EWA, and monitoring.


**Ideally, you’ll also**
* Practical experience managing SAP workloads on Azure or AWS (VMs, storage classes, networking, monitoring).
* Exposure to SAP Cloud ALM (CALM) for monitoring, change control, and operations.
* Exposure to SAP Data Archiving with OpenText


**Certifications:**
* SAP Technology Associate certifications (SAP Basis or HANA).
* SAP Cloud Certifications (RISE, BTP, HANA Cloud, etc.).
* Cloud certification (AWS, Azure and GCP).
* Exposure to enterprise transformation tools such as Signavio and LeanIX for process modeling, architecture governance, and landscape documentation.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:** 
 If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Oracle Cloud Infra Admin-Oracle DBA with OCI-Senior
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**EY GDS –Senior Oracle DBA / OCI Administrator Position**
 Over the last decade, cloud adoption and database modernization have become critical enablers for building scalable, secure, and resilient enterprise platforms globally. To support this rapidly evolving and fast paced cloud transformation landscape, we leverage Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) along with industry best practices in database administration, automation, and cloud architecture to deliver reliable, high performance, and cost effective solutions to our clients.
   

  

 As part of our global EY GDS team, you will work on enterprise scale Oracle database and OCI initiatives, supporting mission critical applications across on premises and cloud environments. You will be involved in solving complex technical challenges, driving large scale database migrations, and contributing to the development of next generation cloud and database platforms.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are offering you a demanding role where you will work on mission critical enterprise database platforms and cloud transformation initiatives. You will leverage your expertise in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), database administration, and cloud migration to design, migrate, and manage highly available and secure database solutions. This position includes the opportunity to collaborate with cross functional teams and supporting large scale cloud adoption.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Database administration, solution design, database migration, and manageability for mission critical enterprise applications across data center and cloud deployments.
* Hands on experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), including database provisioning, maintenance, and operational support.
* Perform core database activities such as patching, troubleshooting, performance optimization, and maintenance.
* Lead and support end to end Oracle application and database migrations from on premises environments to OCI.
* Execute end to end database migrations, including:
+ Virtual network design
+ Routing rules
+ Security configuration
+ Compute instance creation
+ Database deployment and configuration

* Provide production support and upgrades for Oracle databases (12c, 18c, 19c), including cross‑platform migrations.
* Perform Oracle database upgrades from 9i, 10g, and 11g to 12c, 18c, and 19c across multiple platforms.
* Work with additional database technologies such as MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB.
* Collaborate closely with Cloud Infrastructure teams to identify and implement efficient, scalable, and secure cloud\-based solutions.
* Demonstrate strong written and verbal communication skills, effectively collaborating with teams across geographies.
* Flexibility to work independently or as part of a global delivery team to meet project objectives and timelines.
* Support proof of concepts, architectural design sessions, and solution reviews using Oracle Cloud best practices.
* Contribute to automation and optimization initiatives, leveraging DevOps tools where applicable.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with business delivery teams.
* Analytical thinking.
* Strong team\-player and self\-started attitude.
* Ability to create documentation for Proof of Concepts (PoCs).
* Well organized, attentive to details attitude.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a related technology field such as Computer Science, Engineering, MCA, or equivalent.
* 3 to 7 years of relevant experience in architecting, designing, implementing, and/or supporting highly distributed and enterprise\-scale applications.
* Extensive hands‑on experience working with at least one public cloud platform such as Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (preferred) and Azure
* Hands‑on system administration experience on Linux and Solaris platforms.


**Additionally, Good To Have**
* Work with additional database technologies such as MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB.
* Ability to architect optimal technical solutions aligned to customer and business requirements.
* Experience presenting solutions to senior leadership and executive audiences, clearly articulating platform and service benefits.
* Experience acting as technical lead for engagements such as Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Architecture Design sessions, applying best practices on Oracle Cloud.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Strong communication skills to coordinate and resolve queries with both internal and external stakeholders.
* Self‑motivated, result‑oriented mindset with the ability to deliver tasks within defined timelines.
* Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills to address complex technical challenges.
* Public Cloud certification such as Oracle / AWS / Azure / Google Cloud Certified Architect.


**What We Look For**
* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team of 1000\+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Oracle and Enterprise Applications practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.
